book.name: Revelation
book.title: Revelation Jidii Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa Saint John Vats'ą' Gwigweelkįį

content: Nijin Divii Gii (7th) łangwidhidzii nihky'aa oonjik dąį' zheekat ½ hr. datthak łąą ch'iihahchįį kwaa.
Ąįįtł'ęę zheekat gwich'in (7) nąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ts'ą' nigeelzhii ts'ą' 7 trumpets chan goovantł'eerinlii gwał'in.

Ch'izhii zheekat gwich'in tyah ghoo gold nilii vizhit gwanzhįh gwinzii vagwaatsan tr'ahk'an ootą', k'ii'ee tr'iizhii ts'ą' ataiinjii tr'ahtsii deek'it (Altar) ts'ą' nadhat. Gwanzhįh gwinzii vagwaatsan lęįį vantł'eerinlii, ąįį Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa k'injiighit nąįį khagidiinjii nąįį tee reheelyaa ts'ą' ataiinjii tr'ahtsii deek'it kii gold haa gwiltsąįį ąįį k'eedeegwaadhat ts'ą' yakat doodii ęhdaa dha'aii kat nirehee'aa geenjit.
Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa k'injiighit nąįį khagidiinjii ąįį zheekat gwich'in, Vit'eegwijyąhchy'aa ęhdaa nadhat ts'ą' gwanzhįh gwinzii vagwaatsan ahk'an ąįį ts'an łat k'iidak t'ii'in ąįį łat zhit haahjil.

Ąįįtł'ęę zheekat gwich'in gwanzhįh gwinzii vagwaatsan vizhit tr'ahk'an tyah ghoo oonjik, ataiinjii tr'ahtsii deek'it gwats'an kǫ' daak'a' yizhit t'inlik, ts'ą' oozhak nankat gwats'ą' yihiłtł'ik. Ąįį ts'an dzaa nankat, nahtan hahchik ts'ą' nahtan kwan haadhak gwiizhik gwideezhuh dihtth'ak ts'ą' nan gwint'aii daatrat.
Ąįįtł'ęę zheekat gwich'in seven nąįį trumpets seven zhit giheezhool geenjit shriitr'agwagwah'ąįį.
Tr'ookit zheekat gwich'in da-trumpet zhiinzhol. Ch'anlųh, kǫ' haa vitee dah k'iidąą nankat ninlaii. Dzaa nankat ⅓ datthak dhik'in. Gwanzhįh ⅓ datthak, ts'ą' ts'iivii ⅓ datthak haa dhik'in.
Ąįįtł'ęę gwats'ąįį zheekat gwich'in second nilii da-trumpet zhiinzhol. Ddhah choo k'it t'inchy'aa ak'an oondaa chųų choo zhit tr'ąąhnąįį. Chųų choo ⅓ datthak dah naanaii.
Chųų choo vizhit nin gwandaii ⅓ datthak kwaa goodlit, ts'ą' vakat tr'ihchoo choh ⅓ chan an dhidlit.

Tł'ęę zheekat gwich'in third nilii da-trumpet zhiinzhol. Akhai' są' choo, gałtsii kǫ' daak'a' k'it t'inchy'aa oodaa zhee zhit gwats'an tr'aanaii, ts'ą' nan ts'an chųų haiilaii, ts'ą' han gwinjik ⅓ gwakat naanaii an gwiłtsąįį.
(Ąįį są' choo t'ee “Tr'aakaii” oozhii.) chųų ⅓ datthak tr'aakaii naanaii ts'ą' dinjii lęįį nąįį giikhiinii haa nigiinjik, tr'aakaii naanaii geh'an.
Tł'ęę zheekat gwich'in dǫǫ (4th) nilii da-trumpet zhiinzhol. Ąįį geh'an goo'adrii 1⅓ datthak adrii kwaa nagwaanąįį; drin ⅓ datthak ts'ą' tǫǫ ⅓ datthak ch'aadrii kwaa.

Tł'ęę gwał'in ts'ą' oodak niighit ch'izhin nihiniit'ee azhral haa t'inyąą dihtth'ak, “Gwagwantrii! Gwagwantrii! Dzaa nankat gwidinjii nąįį deegwahtł'oo gooveenjit gwigweheetrii li', nijin zhit ch'izhii zheekat gwich'in tik nąįį da-trumpet zhit giinzhol ji'.”
